ROOFING & EXTERIOR EXPERTS IN CINCINNATI, COLUMBUS & ST. LOUIS

The team at Coldstream Exteriors provides trusted roofing, siding, and window services across Ohio, Kentucky, and Missouri. You can count on us to show up, do the work right, and stand behind every project. Our crew is fully insured and certified, so your home is protected from day one. We've earned our BBB A+ rating and 400+ five-star reviews by doing one thing: putting your satisfaction ahead of everything else. No payment is due until your project is complete and you're happy with the results.

Coldstream Exteriors works directly with insurance companies to handle storm damage claims, so you don't have to fight through the red tape alone. We provide free inspections within 24 hours and honest pricing before any work begins. Whether you need a full roof replacement, new siding, or window installation, our experienced team uses quality materials built to last. You'll work with local owners who live in these communities and care about protecting your biggest investment.

Contact us today to schedule your free estimate in Cincinnati, Columbus, or St. Louis. We'll walk your property, answer your questions, and give you clear options with upfront pricing. Call us at (844) 426-8222 or fill out the form to get started.
